description: S005 confirms a 1 May Luanda May Day march organized by central labor unions and attended by employees from several companies, but describes a commemoration and a unity appeal, not a state-directed labor demand; it reports no turnout count. required_followup: Revisit only if independent contemporaneous coverage documents an Angolan-government-directed demand or a qualifying grievance and at least 50 participants. Do not infer protest eligibility or threshold from the ceremonial context.
